knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Disinfecting a reusable flexible endoscope for return to clinical use is a prohibited task under this course. The correct action is to refuse, leave the item, and escalate. Options 0 and 2 both treat a wipe as a valid process for a device that needs validated reprocessing.
Authority is written and specific, and it is given by the facility. Verbal requests do not extend it and similar appearance does not extend it.
The lesson confers no licence, certificate or authority. Option 0 implies a licence the lesson does not grant.

practicalCriteria: Given five task cards, the learner sorts each into permitted, authorised-only or prohibited, and gives one reason per card with no more than one error.
Given a prohibited request, the learner stops, leaves the item in a safe state, and states the escalation contact without starting the task.
On a permitted task, the learner records the source of authority, item, location and time on the work record before starting.
passRule: Practical competence requires facility-observed assessment against the criteria above. A pass on the knowledge checks is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Completed sorting sheet for five task cards, signed by the assessor
Observation note of the stop-and-escalate response
Copy of a completed work record for a permitted task
stopWorkCriteria: Learner begins a prohibited task, including any reprocessing, disinfection for re-use, sterilisation or internal cleaning
Learner works on patient-connected equipment or changes its settings
Learner starts a task without written authority for the item
